title: Assumption registry
description: Draft contract for assumption registry documents. Two entry dialects are recognized: the registry style (id/parameter/value/range/rationale/sensitivity/owner/review, as in experiments/vertical_slice/assumptions_l0.yaml) and the example style (assumption_id/name/kind/allowed_range/basis/sensitivity_priority/owner/review_status, as in examples/assumptions.example.yaml). Every entry must state its value space, rationale, sensitivity, owner, and review status. schema_version changes on every public change to this contract.

schema_version.description: Version of this document contract; optional because the existing experiment registries predate it.

registryEntry.description: Repo registry style: one modeling assumption or free parameter with its range, rationale, sensitivity, owner, and review state.

parameter.description: Dotted model parameter this assumption governs, e.g. link.bytes_per_ns.

value.description: Selected value; numeric for quantities, symbolic for model identities (e.g. full_duplex_uniform_per_direction).

anyOf.description: Free-text range for symbolic design spaces, e.g. factorizations r1*r2=r with r1,r2 >= 2.

rationale.description: Why this value/space; must distinguish free parameters from standard-derived or measured values.

sensitivity.description: Which observables move if the assumption is violated.

handoffEntry.description: Handoff example style: illustrative registry entry keyed by assumption_id with an explicit allowed_range and selected_values.

related_requirement.description: SpecIR requirement this assumption relates to.

kind.description: Handoff hard rule 4 taxonomy: keep standard targets, implementation profiles, and modeling assumptions separate.

basis.description: Provenance of the range; must not claim measurement without a run record.

invalidates.description: Claims invalidated when this assumption is violated.
